name: Service charges and leaseholder accounts
one_line: Refused specialization for building budgets, demands, apportionments, reconciliations and leaseholder accounts: the cycle is already part of the construction_property default, while the remaining distinctions are property, tenant and billing-stage values.
refuse_reason: Fails all three template-node legs. Detection fails because the deepened construction_property default already names an apportionment structure and service-charge budget, demand and reconciliation work types; invoice/account, property, unit, landlord and tenant observations add only role values and billing-stage work_type values. Dimensions fail because this field-less schema requires the same empty dimension_order as its default; building, service-charge period and unit are undeclared. Privacy fails to differ because the default already protects tenant, address, payment and dispute material. The gist verdict is reversed: the files remain covered by the schema default, independently active neighbours, groups and residuals.

deterministic: None unique: a building budget plus unit apportionment, demands and reconciliation is deterministic evidence for the construction_property default, which already owns that structure.
No invoice or account routes here merely because its subject is a building or its counterparty is a leaseholder; those are role values, not a second template.
needs_llm: Nothing routes to this refused node. Review may choose the construction_property default, Finance, tenancy management, facilities/workplace, or a residual. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”
A model may propose group membership but may not copy a property, unit, tenant, period, amount or payment-status fact onto sparse members.
never_alone: service charge, demand, account, invoice, budget, reconciliation, reserve fund or apportionment alone; these are document-function or work_type values
a property address, block, unit number, landlord, managing agent or tenant name alone
an amount, percentage share, due date, accounting period or arrears balance alone

a source_type or extension alone; “The engine should treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning, inspect the real MIME type or file signature where possible, and dispatch each file to a type-specific extractor.”
a portal folder or download session alone; “A session should never be treated as proof of topic, and it should not carry the same confidence as a hash match or a directly extracted document fact.”

grouping_reasons: The graph may assemble estimate, demands, apportionment, actual-cost account and balancing statement around one building and period under the construction_property default; that does not activate this row.
A tenancy group may contain a lease, rent ledger, service-charge demand and correspondence while every member retains only its own facts.
An isolated demand remains transactional; nearby files do not copy property, tenant, period or payment facts onto it.

template.why: Empty because the row is refused and construction_property declares no destination fields. Building, service-charge period and unit are undeclared; billing stage is only work_type. The schema default already holds property/site -> instruction -> document function in prose, with a period where the situation cycles.

must_not_conclude: a calendar year from the period
an undeclared property or unit fact

observations: manifest lists budgets, demands, accounts and correspondence

must_not_conclude: service charge from any property demand

falls_through_to.why: Standalone demands, invoices and confirmations fit 00's residual for “isolated invoices, delivery confirmations, booking records, boarding passes, purchase receipts, event tickets, and similar transactional documents.”
Durable budgets, accounts and notices may remain standalone records without a duplicate template.
Named arrears and dispute material may need a protected isolated home; protection is not dependent on this refused node.
Role-ambiguous statements may be partly understood without a safe final situation.
Unreadable management packs remain represented without invented member facts.

sensitivity_why: Demands and arrears schedules expose names, home addresses, unit identifiers, account references, balances and disputes. Refusal does not weaken P7 or independently active safety-schema protection and assigns no handling class.
open_question: NEEDS-JOSEPH: should shared property/asset and operational accounting-period keys be added for grouping across construction_property, tenancy, facilities and Finance? This would not rescue this row: billing stage remains work_type and the enriched default still owns the cycle.
